in_marathi.name: Avedyan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avedyan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Avedyan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Avedana' which means 'to know'. This name is given to a child who is believed to possess vast knowledge and wisdom from a young age.
